QuestInfo.name: Deal with the Shadowdealers 2
QuestInfo.0: #bRomero#k of the Shadowdealers in #bDowntown Black Market#k has something to say.
QuestInfo.1: He thinks he can make big money if you get the #bSpecter's Sword Pieces#k by defeating the #rWarrior Specters#k. Get him #b40 Specter's Sword Pieces#k.
QuestInfo.2: You got the Specter's Sword Pieces for Romero.

0.0: Hey there! Quite a lot of people came for my potions after I made that deal with you! I haven't officially started to deal with the Nova themselves, but it's only a matter of time now. #bI'll push out Tonero and take his place#k! Ahahaha!
0.1: By the way, I still haven't found that #bace of the Reclamation HQ#k. I thought they'd be easy to find, all flashy and heroic, but I don't know where they're cooped up. Well, I guess I'll run into them someday. Anyway, I've got a new deal for you.

yes.0: Do you know about the #bSpecter's Sword Pieces#k you can get by defeating the #rWarrior Specters#k? You can melt them down and make powerful weapons of your own. Or so I hear...but I want to know for myself!
yes.1: If you can get me just #b40 Specter's Sword Pieces#k, I'll make you an offer you can't refuse!

no.0: What? Do you have something urgent to do? Well, hurry back!

1.0: Oh, did you bring the Specter's Sword Pieces?

yes.0: Wow. So this is a Specter's Sword Piece. I've only ever heard about them, but now that I see it, I get how you can make great weapons from them. This is going straight back to Savage Terminal!
yes.1: Another excellent deal closed! I look forward to working with you again!

item.0: Get me just #b40 Specter's Sword Pieces#k by defeating the #rWarrior Specters#k! I'll make you an offer you can't refuse!
